text:
anya: Pushed gpu-operator v1.4.0 to us-west-2 just now, seeing a lot of pods requesting GPUs stuck Pending. device-plugin logs show driver/kernel mismatch. Can someone take a look?

anya: kubectl describe pod gpu-trainer-7f8d
Events:
  Type    Reason             Age   From               Message
  ----    ------             ----  ----               -------
  Warning FailedScheduling   2m    default-scheduler  0/120 nodes are available: 120 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.

anya: device-plugin logs:
```
ERROR failed to register device plugin: driver api mismatch: user-space driver 525.60.13 != kernel module 525
NVIDIA Driver API: 525.60.13
Kernel module: 525
```

cheng: Did we also push a kernel/driver update? last kernel batch was only for eu-west yesterday.
cheng: Which node series is hit? g4/g5? Any label differences?

mike: Looks like G5a and G5 in the pool. Some nodes running kernel 5.10.x with driver package pinned to 525.60.13, kernel module was rebuilt as 525 by the operator change? odd.

julia: If device-plugin changed how it detects driver ABI, it might reject nodes with minor-version mismatches. Short term we can revert the gpu-operator daemonset to v1.3.9 and let kubelet keep serving existing allocations.

infra-bot: Deployment gpu-operator v1.4.0 -> image redwood/gpu-operator:v1.4.0 deployed at 2026-03-18T10:00:00Z :rocket:

sergey: Avoid a full cluster drain, we can't due to Dedicated reserved workloads (costly to reprovision). Suggested triage:
- restart kubelet on 6 affected nodes to reload nvidia modules
- check /var/log/messages and dmesg for nvidia module load failures

sergey: quick commands:
```
ssh node-xyz
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
sudo rmmod nvidia_uvm || true
sudo modprobe nvidia_uvm
journalctl -u kubelet -f
```

mike: Restarting kubelet helped for 2 nodes, device-plugin re-registered but still seeing some pods get "Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu".

julia: There is also a NCCL lib path change in 1.4.0 that switches symlink from /usr/lib/libnccl.so.2 -> libnccl.so.2.14. Containers expecting old path can fail init and release allocations. Check init containers mounting host lib paths.

ops-oncall: I'll coordinate a partial rollback to v1.3.9 for us-west-2 starting in 10m and schedule kernel/driver reconciliation for weekend. Can't do full kernel update during business hours.

anya: Plan: rollback gpu-operator to v1.3.9 on canary subset (10 nodes), monitor pod scheduling for 30m, then expand. If that fails, we'll manual-driver-patch nodes with driver 525.60.13.

mike: +1. I'll prepare the rollback manifest and a quick script to patch the daemonset image and pause the rollout for manual verification.

anya: Thanks all — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
